تفتحلي (form VIII)
# تَفْتَحِلِي (taftaḥilī) /taf.ta.ħi.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
# تُفْتَحَلِي (tuftaḥalī) /tuf.ta.ħa.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
